messages.subject: WAIC with survival models
parts:
If I use anything other than a Cox model, I get the following error when trying to return the WAIC:

Assertion failed: (0 == 1), function GMRFLib_ai_po_integrate, file approx-inference.c, line 6649.

Rescaling the outcome had no effect, though the error here is clearly different than the one listed in the documentation.

Any thoughts?

Adam
